title: RelBench Classification + Avito Stress-Test Tasks with FK-Join Cardinality Profiles
summary: Demo notebook for the RelBench Classification + Avito Stress-Test dataset with FK-Join Cardinality Profiles. Loads 12 structured prediction examples (3 per dataset) across 4 RelBench dataset-task pairs: rel-f1/driver-dnf, rel-stack/user-engagement, rel-hm/user-churn, and rel-avito/ad-ctr. Demonstrates parsing FK cardinality profiles from structured input text, displays cross-dataset summary with danger scores, and visualizes mean FK cardinality per edge (log scale) and FK danger scores as bar chart. Highlights Avito's extreme cardinality (mean=114,625) as the structural cause of PRMP failure.
